name: Dermatology clinic
summary: How expats find dermatology care in Singapore — eczema and acne pathways, mole checks, aesthetic vs medical visits, and insurance panel realities.
body:
Dermatologists manage medical skin disease and some procedural care. Expats often mix humid-climate eczema flares, adult acne, and mole checks. Keep medical and purely aesthetic bookings conceptually separate when reading insurance rules.

## Decision points
- GP management vs dermatology referral
- Eczema / dermatitis flare plans in humidity
- Mole mapping and biopsy pathways
- Medical visit vs aesthetic add-ons
- Panel clinic vs private cash rates

Bring a photo timeline of rashes and a list of creams already tried.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that triage urgent flares and explain steroid / non-steroid laddering. Ask who reviews biopsy results. Confirm whether follow-ups are bundled.

## Practical tip
Photograph rashes in the same light each morning for a week before the visit. Descriptions alone under-sell how fast humidity flares change.
